checks: Construction forest (one parent edge per non-source node)
Loop edges join existing nodes and are never parent edges
Every node reachable from a source
Every active service reachable through enabled edges
Meters resolve by premiseId or servicePointId
Electric radial: no cycles through energized edges; feeder ties explicit and normally open
No gas service without gas mains in the district
